title.en: Fairness · Twelve Essays in Eight Languages
title.zh: 公平论：十二篇八语全文

summary.en: All twelve essays are now available in full in Japanese, French, German, Spanish and Korean as well as English and Chinese.
summary.zh: 十二篇新增日语、法语、德语、西班牙语与韩语全文，原有简繁中文与英文正文保留。
